scope: Two Provider and 22 Viewport direct assertion mappings. DOM evidence does not confer browser focus, Portal, or shared-manifest credit.

cases.adaptations: Committed Svelte pre/mount effects replace React layout effects; Suspense leaf is excluded.

cases.title: rebinds owner-document listeners once across empty store cycles
cases.adaptations: Native events/owner-document inline mount and explicit focus guard dispatch; real Tab traversal is separate browser evidence. Review regression correction: window blur/focus listeners remain attached for the mounted Viewport lifetime, including empty stores. Source assertions 113/114 observe zero empty-transition removals and 126/127 retain one registration; keydown/pointerdown still rebind once per nonempty cycle. This explicit lifecycle adaptation receives no shared credit.
